svg.title: Orchestrator + Subagents
svg.desc: The user query goes to the orchestrator, or lead agent. The orchestrator dispatches work to Subagent 1, Subagent 2 and Subagent 3, each with its own context and scoped tools; the link to Subagent 2 is drawn two-way. All three subagents feed Result Synthesis. The orchestrator delivers the final output to the user.
svg.text: A lead agent fans work out to subagents, each with its own context and scoped tools.
